keyVerseDR: "Suffer the little children to come unto me and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God." (Mk 10:14)

level1.title: Jesus Loves Children
level1.story: People brought little children to Jesus. The disciples tried to stop them. Jesus said, "Let the children come to Me!" and He blessed them.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What did Jesus do with the children?
How can you come to Jesus?
level1.prayer: Jesus, thank You for loving me. Amen.

activity.title: Jesus loves children
activity.intro: Draw yourself and your friends with Jesus.

level2.title: Let the Children Come
level2.story: The Pharisees asked Jesus about marriage, and He said, "What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder." People brought young children to Jesus so He could touch them, and the disciples scolded them. Jesus was displeased and said, "Suffer the little children to come unto Me, and forbid them not; for of such is the kingdom of God." He said whoever does not receive the kingdom like a child shall not enter it. Embracing the children, He laid His hands on them and blessed them.
level2.keyLine: Suffer the little children to come unto me.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why does Jesus say marriage is from God?
How can you receive God's kingdom like a child?
level2.prayer: Jesus, bless our family and keep us close. Amen.

activity.title: Family talk
items: How can our family welcome others?
What do we love about our family?
